# Colophon {.unnumbered}

This book was produced with [Quarto](https://quarto.org),
typeset in [Source Serif 4](https://fonts.adobe.com/fonts/source-serif),
with code blocks set in [JetBrains
Mono](https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/). The command
examples target Git 2.40 or later and the GitHub CLI (`gh`)
2.40 or later.

The book is hosted at <https://git-intermediate.rgtlab.org>
on Netlify, with continuous deployment via GitHub Actions
from the `rgt47/git-intermediate` repository on every push
to `main`. The deployment recipe is in `HOSTING.md`.

The cover is generated procedurally by
`images/build-cover.R` from a slate gradient anchored on
`#2c4a5e` (the volume's brand steel blue). Re-running the
script regenerates the cover; the procedural approach makes
it reproducible and editable in version control rather than
dependent on a one-shot image-generation step.

Last rendered: see the build timestamp on the homepage.
